question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seated around a round table facing the center. G sits second to the left of E. B sits third to the right of A. C is the immediate neighbour of both E and B. D sits immediate left of G. How many people sit between E and F when counted from the right of E?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seated around a round table facing the center.

G sits second to the left of E.

D sits immediate left of G.

C is the immediate neighbour of both E and B.
